claims.quote: They returned to the east step at dusk with the scroll wrapped in the Elder's cloth and the pebble still set where Mercy had left it.
claims.value: Elder and Mercy bring scroll to east step breadcrumb; witnesses present

claims.quote: "—moved to side-yard—" ... "Here: a note in a different hand—'placed, not named'." ... "—page torn—name rubbed—'—wan'—then: 'moved to side-yard'—"
claims.value: Elder reads fragments: 'moved to side-yard', 'placed, not named', torn page, rubbed names (fragmented evidence of erasure)

claims.quote: "That night," he said, "we heard them calling from the stairwell. We... we knew if we opened our door the patrols might—" He stopped... "We put out lights. We hid what we could. We told our children to sleep. We did not... we did not carry them out."
claims.value: Reluctant testimony (neighbor) reveals practice of hiding and not rescuing, presented without naming perpetrators

claims.quote: "We will offer a different thing," she said. "We will name what we can with witnesses. The Elder reads the fragment; a witness says what they saw; we place a pebble; we offer rice and tea; an offering is made for what we cannot say aloud. We do not point fingers beyond what witnesses swear."
claims.value: Mercy proposes witnessed naming ritual with Elder's scroll reading, offerings, pebble placement, witness limits, and no public accusations

claims.quote: "Names cost," he said softly. "But the city is full of unpaid costs. Bearing them is a duty, and a danger. If we do this, we do it with witnesses and a plan to hold the living through what naming releases."
claims.value: Elder warns naming carries cost; insists on witnesses and plan to support community

claims.quote: The spirit—ever the sum of these silences—stirred. Voices layered into a single, thin howl that ran up from the stairwell and shook the tiles; a gust of cold moved through the yard and a laundry line snapped taut as if struck.
claims.value: spirit reacts to revealed testimony and scroll reading with intensified howl, cold gust, physical effects

claims.quote: Mercy laid out the small procedure—powdered incense in the dented censer, closed talismans at the ready, small bowls of rice and tea as offerings, two witnesses for each memory, pebble placement repeated aloud, and the scroll's fragment read first to set context.
claims.value: Mercy outlines witnessed naming ritual plan: incense, closed talismans, offerings, two witnesses per memory, pebble placement, Elder reads scroll fragment first

claims.quote: Neighbor Lei swallowed and spoke before others could. "I will stand. I will bear witness to what I remember. I will place a pebble and repeat what I saw." His voice made a small ripple; others shifted and two more hands rose. The witness list began, not yet full, but no longer empty.
claims.value: Initial volunteers for witnessed naming (Neighbor Lei and others) begin to form a witness list

claims.quote: They set the date: at first light, with offerings, witnesses, the scroll read, and the pebble-marked east step presented as place to be named.
claims.value: Witnessed naming scheduled at first light at east step; preparations to gather scroll and witnesses planned
